about.label: The person behind the music
about.title: Personal, Professional, Unique.
about.paragraph1: Based in the heart of Hamburg, I combine years of experience in the events industry with a deep passion for excellent acoustics. At Prinz Entertainment, it's not just about playlists – it's about atmosphere.
about.paragraph2: I believe every event has its own soul. That's why I place great emphasis on detailed planning and personal consultation to bring your vision to life sonically. Reliability and a discreet, professional presence are my foundation.
